description: Node-source is the read step of CodeKit's function/method whole-node replacement workflow. Use it to fetch the exact current function/method source before review or before sending a complete replacement to patch. Normal output contains the current source and target location without runtime hashes or overflow metadata. Non-function symbols such as enum, enum variant/member, struct field, type alias, and statement-level nodes are not returned.

nodes.description: Required node input. Each item must include file and structural_path for a function/method target. structural_path is one slash-separated structural path suffix, not a regex or glob. For same-file batches repeat the same file or use newline-separated structural_path values in one item.

file.description: Explicit source file path that owns the target function or method node.

structural_path.description: Slash-separated structural path suffix for a function/method node such as main, UserService/get_user, impl MyType/new, or impl MyTrait for MyType/run.

max_nodes.description: Advanced batch safety limit. Maximum function/method node requests to process before marking the rest as skipped. Defaults to 20; omit it for normal use.
